findings.issue: energy_type vocabulary: 5 values including fuel in schema delta s2.1 / ARCH-02 s10.2 vs 4 values in the Scope 2 domain matrix.
findings.decision: One authoritative Scope 2 vocabulary: electricity | heat | steam | cooling. fuel is NOT a Scope 2 energy type.
findings.rationale: Scope 2 is purchased energy; fuel-borne energy is a Scope 1 (combustion) or Scope 3 activity identified by the activity/factor. A Scope 1/Scope 3 row carries energy_type = NULL.
findings.arch_04_action: Schema delta s2.1 CHECK reduced to 4 values with rationale; ARCH-02 s10.2 annotated; the Scope 2 matrix energy_type entry states the authoritative vocabulary and the fuel exclusion.
